channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Balancing Duty and Dreams, Delhi Police ACP Apurva Verma Secures AIR 42 in UPSC CSE 2025
item.description: Apurva Verma, a Delhi Police ACP, achieved All India Rank 42 in UPSC 2025 while managing high-pressure police duties, showcasing exceptional dedication and perseverance.

item.title: Explosions Rock Abu Dhabi, Dubai & Riyadh: Iran’s Relentless Missile Blitz Enters Sixth Day Across the Gulf
item.description: Iran's missile and drone blitz across Abu Dhabi and Riyadh has killed migrants, hit the US Embassy, and pushed the Gulf to the brink.

item.title: Saudi Arabia Intercepts 5 Missiles And 5 Drones Targeting Al-Kharj And Riyadh Amid Rising Gulf Tensions
item.description: Saudi air defences shot down missiles and drones targeting key sites near Riyadh as regional tensions intensified following recent Iran-Israel escalation.

item.title: ‘Every Ride, Non-Stop Calls’: Bengaluru Woman’s Post On 4 Auto Trips Triggers Safety Debate
item.description: A Bengaluru commuter’s viral post about drivers speaking on calls throughout auto rides has triggered debate on road safety and smartphone dependence.

item.title: Emirates Partially Restarts Flights from Dubai After Temporary Suspension Amid Missile Alerts and Airspace Disruptions
item.description: Emirates has partially restarted flights from Dubai following a temporary suspension triggered by missile alerts, ensuring passenger safety amid ongoing regional airspace disruptions.

item.title: Pakistani National Asif Merchant Convicted In US For Iran-Linked Plot To Assassinate Donald Trump
item.description: Brooklyn federal jury convicted Pakistani national Asif Merchant for Iran-linked plot to hire hitmen targeting Donald Trump.

item.title: Karnataka: Man Allegedly Kills Friend For ₹2.5 Lakh, Uses Stolen Money To Buy Gifts For Estranged Wife
item.description: A man in Karnataka allegedly murdered his close friend for ₹2.5 lakh and used part of the stolen money to buy gifts for his estranged second wife in an attempt to reconcile.

item.title: Iranian Drone Intercepted Near Dubai International Airport, Smoke Erupts, Forcing Temporary Shutdown of Airport Operations
item.description: An Iranian drone attack on DXB forces temporary suspension of flights, with UAE air defences successfully intercepting threats and no reported injuries.

item.title: MP Man, Freed from Jail, Kills Teen; Locals Witness Him Eating Victim’s Brain, Drinking Blood
item.description: A recently released inmate allegedly murdered a 16‑year‑old in Madhya Pradesh, sparked cannibalism claims, and sparked a tense village standoff before his arrest.

item.title: Logical Take: West Asia War and India – Why a Distant Conflict Could Reshape India’s Economy and Security
item.description: India faces economic, energy, and strategic risks as the West Asia conflict disrupts trade, oil supplies, and diaspora safety.
